title: Array-Vector Multiply
source_docs: DSP System Toolbox/Math Functions/Matrices and Linear Algebra/Matrix Operations/Array_Vector_Multiply.md
text: Multiply array by vector along specified dimension, 2 inputs, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Rounding mode} sets Method of rounding operation; {Multiply along dimension} sets the dimension along which to multiply input, {Vector (V) source} sets the source of vector, {Vector (V)} sets the vector parameter, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action, {Vector (V) Minimum} sets the minimum value for elements of vector, {Vector (V) Maximum} sets the maximum value for elements of vector, {Product output}, {Accumulator}, {Output}, {Output Minimum} sets the minimum value of block output, {Output Maximum} sets the maximum value of block output and {Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Multiply along dimension
params.values: Dimension along which to multiply input array 2 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Vector (V) source
params.values: Source of vector Input port (default) | Dialog parameter

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: Method of rounding operation Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Method of overflow action off (default) | on

params.name: Vector (V) Minimum
params.values: Minimum value for elements of vector [] (unspecified) (default) | scalar

params.name: Vector (V) Maximum
params.values: Maximum value for elements of vector [] (unspecified) (default) | scalar

params.name: Product output
params.values: Product output data type Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as first input | fixdt([],16,0) |

params.name: Accumulator
params.values: Accumulator data type Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as first input | Inherit: Same as product output | fixdt([],16,0) |

params.name: Output
params.values: Output data type Inherit: Same as product output (default) | Inherit: Same as first input | Inherit: Same as first input | fixdt([],16,0) |

params.name: Output Minimum
params.values: Minimum value of block output [] (unspecified) (default) | scalar

params.name: Output Maximum
params.values: Maximum value of block output [] (unspecified) (default) | scalar

params.name: Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Prevent fixed-point tools from overriding data types off (default) | on
